And when you come back you get the usual routine: towel, clean your paws one by one, mud on the floor and on the sofa, and that wet dog smell that lasts for hours. Meanwhile, he's still there shaking, and you can't do anything until he dries up completely.😶‍🌫️ And the worst thing is that it repeats itself on every walk with rain, every week That's why this raincoat exists: covers the back, belly, head with hood and the 4 legs with elastic cuff. It is put on in seconds with the front zipper, carries reflective bands for walks in low light and returns home dry from head to toe Take it off at the door and that's it: dry dog, clean house and zero towel. 🤗❤️‍🩹
